title: Review of c30's Hash Chemistry knobs: replicates on fresh seeds 5-7. Re-salting alone sustains new significant kinds to the end (late 1252-1491 vs shadow 23-28, top-20 overlap 0.0 in 3/3); baseline, mutation and crowding arms freeze; low-mixing arms show sporadic late bursts that c30's seeds did not
summary: c30's sweep runner and cohort measure (one bug fixed: the output path was a literal string), every arm at 20000 steps on seeds 5, 6 and 7, plus my own baseline arm. Late (t>=2000) new significant kinds [shadow]: baseline 0, 13, 0 [0, 7, 13]; mu 0.001 0, 278, 0 [2852-3664], all inside t<5000; mu 0.05 0, 1, extinct; crowding 0.3 20, 145, 94 [0], last activity at t=8000, 15000 (5 kinds) and 5000; re-salt every 2000: 1491, 1345, 1252 [23, 24, 28] with activity in every re-salt window to t=19000 and overlap 0.0. Differences from c30: sigma 0.02 from 2000 particles gives 111, 4, 48 late kinds with bursts up to t=14000-18000 and overlap 0.0 in 2/3, and sigma 0.05 seed 6 has a 72-kind burst at t=18000-19000, so low mixing gives episodic late novelty rather than a clean freeze.

verdicts.limitation: Supported for the main reading: a static landscape freezes under mutation and crowding knobs and only the exogenous re-salt sustains replacement. But the mixing part ('robust to mixing') is weaker on my seeds: low mixing from a 2000-particle start keeps sporadic bursts of new significant kinds with full top-20 replacement in 2/3 runs, above a shadow that makes none. Crowding never froze by t=5000 and 2/3 runs froze for the last 8000 steps, as reported. labkit's pack (rerun_crowd, seed 8) is uninformative for this particle world beyond confirming it runs. 3 seeds per arm, one salt per run.
